newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex may be buying back shares-analysts.
newsitem.headline: Telmex may be buying back shares-analysts.

text.p: Brokerage analysts said the 149.35 million share cross trade of Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) series L stock Friday on Mexico's exchange floor could be the company repurchasing its own shares.

"I think it is part of the repurchase begun in December. Today's operation will bring about 190 million (shares) to total 951.2 (million shares) already approved," said an analyst who declined to be identified.
On Dec. 10, the telephone company approved an increase in reserves by up to 14.233 billion pesos to repurchase stock, with which it could buy as much as 800 million of its shares.
In 1995 the company repurchased 151.2 million shares, the analyst said.
The cross trade took place at the opening of trading Friday by brokerage Inbursa, part of a financial group which has corporate ties with the telephone company.
Telmex shares were up slightly before the market's close with a 0.15 percent rise in the series L issue to 13.06 pesos and a 0.3 percent boost in the series A issue to 13.04 pesos per share.
